channel.title: The Grant Desk - EU, added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: EU, added in last 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 7 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:

    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
